intro: E-commerce, web hosting, and publishing sectors face heightened risk from a cluster of WordPress vulnerabilities, with 13 articles published between April 13 and May 19, 2026. The archive covers four critical, five high, and four medium severity issues, including CVE-2026-4883 and CVE-2026-6433, both scoring 9.8 on the CVSS scale, alongside three medium-severity CVEs from 2021: CVE-2021-47926, CVE-2021-47927, and CVE-2021-47929. These flaws impact organizations globally across technology and digital media, with a severity mix of four critical, five medium, and four high.
